```powershell
function Test-IPv4 {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$Address
    )

    # Regex breakdown:
    # ^ and $ : Start and end of string
    # (?:(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)\.){3} : Matches first 3 octets + dot
    # (?:25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?) : Matches 4th octet
    # To prevent leading zeros (e.g., 01), we use a specific pattern for each octet:
    # 25[0-5] | 2[0-4][0-9] | 1[0-9][0-9] | [1-9]?[0-9]
    
    $octet = '(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|1[0-9][0-9]|[1-9]?[0-9])'
    $pattern = "^$octet\.$octet\.$octet\.$octet$"

    if ($Address -match $pattern) {
        return $true
    }
    return $false
}
```
